blocks.html: As יהוה’s proxy and perfect human image (reflection) of the Glory of יהוה, Yahushua is called by titles. The titles below have been used in justification of the Trinity, and incarnation. The titles below must be understood IN CONTEXT of the entire Word of יהוה to understand them.
blocks.text: As יהוה’s proxy and perfect human image (reflection) of the Glory of יהוה, Yahushua is called by titles.  The titles below have been used in justification of the Trinity, and incarnation.  The titles below must be understood IN CONTEXT of the entire Word of יהוה to understand them.

blocks.html: The first title “Mighty Elohim” is in context referring to Yahushua as the “perfect human image of the invisible Elohim”. • The second title below “Father of Everlasting” is not saying Yahushua is the Everlasting Father יהוה. That title, like Avraham who is called the “Father of Faith” meaning the forefather of faith, is referring to the fact that Yahushua is the forerunner or forefather to attain eternal life; he is the first born son.

blocks.html: "For to us a child is born, to us a son is given, and the government shall be on his shoulders and he will be called Wonderful Counsellor, (Qolasim/Colossians 1:15 the perfect image of) Mighty Elohim, (fore) Father of Everlasting (life Qorintiyim Aleph/1 Corinthians 15:20), and Prince of Peace (Eph. 2:14)." There will be no end to the increase of His government or of peace, on the Throne of David and over His Kingdom, to establish it and to uphold it with justice and righteousness from then on and forevermore.
